description: Land Title Settlement Department - Homagama, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520001 and Others Title Settlements
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land titles for specific parcels in Homagama. It contains detailed schedules with land parcel numbers, ownership details, extents, and encumbrances - all characteristic of land-related administrative matters. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette, confirming its focus on land registration and title settlement.
